rationale: World Bank Western Balkans payments-modernization programme hub keeps producing citable Kosovo payment-cost and SEPA benchmarks.
Single archived CBK governor speech on BIS — strong evidence artifact; the BIS review archive itself would be the monitored parent.
RBI media hub is a durable feed carrying the annual CEE banking sector benchmark covering Kosovo.
EBRD PSD database continuously discloses credit lines and counterparties for Kosovo banks, with sr-language versions.
BiEPAG publishes a recurring paper/blog series on Western Balkans financial integration; useful interpretive counterweight.
One-off UNDP AML typologies PDF — valuable sr-language evidence and terminology, not a recurring signal stream.
Single low-credibility trade-blog post on SEPA accession; re-check whether the site has a durable, verifiable feed.
Single ECB speech page; relevant to euroised Kosovo's SEPA/TARGET access but the ECB speech index is the real hub.
Official Gazette portal is the legal ground truth for banking and payment-services law, searchable and multilingual.
Assembly draft-law register is the earliest formal signal of banking/payments legislation; URL verification failed, needs a liveness re-check.
Budget/finance committee page is a section of kuvendikosoves.org already covered by the parent; verification failed.
Economy committee hearings on the assemblyofkosovo.org mirror carry industry positions and actor lists; URL unverified, re-check.
Sitting calendar is a scheduling sub-page of the Assembly site; useful routing aid, not standalone; verification failed.
Mandatory public-consultation portal publishes every draft banking/payments act months before gazetting; trilingual.
Sponsoring ministry site is the origin point for payment-services and banking bill announcements and fiscal material.
Treasury pages are a section of the MFPT domain but carry direct operational signals on government payment rails.
Fiscal and public-debt reporting is an MFPT sub-section; core structural indicator for bank balance sheets.
Tax administration legislation hub drives fiscalisation and cash-vs-card rules affecting POS demand; URL failed, re-verify.
National Audit Office publishes recurring audits of Treasury controls and IT systems — non-voluntary disclosure of payment-system weaknesses.
Government/PM portal posts approved draft laws and decisions weeks before Assembly registration.
FIU-K publishes recurring AML/CFT reports and bank-product risk assessments that bind banks and PSPs.
Serbian-language view of the same GZK portal; keep as a language variant of the parent gazette source.
BQK legal-framework repository is a durable, well-organised mirror of banking/payments law; overlaps the regulator cell but worth cross-check.
Constitutional Court judgments can void gazetted financial-sector laws — mandatory reconciliation layer for legal tracking.
Official ministry Facebook feed is a fast tripwire for Treasury notices but platform access/scraping must be cleared by a human.
National statistics office with an API-backed endpoint supplies the denominators for banking and payments adoption metrics.
Single gazette act defining the audit-office mandate; reference document, not a recurring signal stream.
Audit-firm licensing register is a one-time actor map for who signs Kosovo bank statements; exact URL unconfirmed and verification failed.
